goal: Move the account UI in the Frisson header to the right: a round avatar button (initials fallback) that toggles an accessible right-aligned dropdown with a name/@username/verified header, View profile, Edit profile and Log out; signed-out Log in / Sign up also sit on the right. Pure web change in apps/web.
constraints: Only apps/web changes (App.vue, optionally a new component under apps/web/src/components, tests, styles); no changes to API, packages/shared or migrations
No new dependencies (package.json and lockfile unchanged)
No v-html anywhere in changed files
Frisson sign and tagline stay as they are; style with existing base.css tokens (no new hard-coded palette)
Trigger is a <button> with aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded, accessible name containing the user's name; menu role=menu, items role=menuitem
Escape closes and refocuses trigger; outside click closes; choosing an item or any route change closes
Log out reuses the existing logOut logic: redirect to library off requiresAuth routes, and role=alert error message on failure
Initials logic identical to ProfileView (two letters of first two words, else first two chars, uppercased; falls back to username)
Signed-out Log in / Sign up hidden on their own pages as today
No dashes as filler in prose/comments/UI copy beyond what existing copy already uses
assumptions: Existing nav.user-menu tests in App.test.ts are obsolete and will be rewritten to the new structure
The dropdown wrapper keeps a nav/aria-label Account landmark and class user-menu (tests may query it); trigger gets class avatar-btn
Menu items for View profile and Edit profile are RouterLinks (role=menuitem) and Log out is a button (role=menuitem)
Menu is closed by default and only renders its items when open (v-if)

Narrow screens: header becomes position relative with the account control absolutely positioned top right, and the sign gets side padding so it cannot be overlapped; verified by CSS review, not pixel test
No arrow-key roving focus is required; Tab order is sufficient; focus moving to first item on open is optional
Avatar image uses session.user.avatarUrl as-is with alt empty or the name, same as ProfileView
Tests use existing happy-dom/vue-test-utils setup; document-level listeners are removed on unmount
risks: happy-dom focus and document click behavior may need attachTo: document.body in tests
Outside-click listener leaks or fires on the trigger click itself (double toggle) if not handled
Absolute positioning may overlap the centered sign on very narrow widths; padding must be reserved
Menu stays open after navigation if the route watcher is missing
Long display names overflow the dropdown; needs max-width and wrapping/ellipsis
Old tests and any selectors using nav.user-menu a.who break and must be updated

acceptanceCriteria.text: Signed-in header renders a button.avatar-btn with aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded=false initially, and an accessible name containing the display name; test 'renders an avatar trigger with menu semantics' passes

acceptanceCriteria.text: Initials fallback: with avatarUrl null the trigger shows 'AC' for 'Alice Cooper', and falls back to username initials ('AL') when displayName is empty; with avatarUrl set it renders an img with that src; tests 'shows initials when there is no avatar' and 'shows the avatar image when avatarUrl is set' pass
acceptanceCriteria.check: cd apps/web && npx vitest run src/App.test.ts -t 'shows initials when there is no avatar' && npx vitest run src/App.test.ts -t 'shows the avatar image when avatarUrl is set'
